basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer living in Norman, Oklahoma. I recently graduated with a degree in Biology, which explains my interest in subreddits like 'APBioNBC' and 'VitalSynth'. I spend most of my evenings online, usually after work where I intern at a local environmental lab. I'm single and love to unwind by playing Gears of War with friends. My other interests include watching horror movies and revisiting my favorite childhood game, FFXI. Despite being new to Reddit, I've quickly become fond of the community's diverse discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from my academic background in biology, which I often apply to discussions in subreddits like 'VitalSynth'. I also have a keen interest in entertainment, especially video games and movies, which is mostly self-taught through years of gaming and movie-watching.
